answer: For every integer d≥8, put n=λ(d−1)+1 and N=n+binom(n,2). Let X consist of the singletons and pairs of [n], let I={(v,e):v∈[n], e∈binom([n],2), v∈e}, J={(v,e):v∈[n], e∈binom([n],2), v∉e}, and ℛ=(I×[3])⊔J. Let 𝒞 be the set of distinct sets C(a,ℓ)={(v,e,i)∈I×[3]:a(v)=a(e), ℓ(v)=i}∪{(v,e)∈J:a(v)>a(e)}, as a:X→{0,…,N−1} and ℓ:X→[3] range over functions satisfying a(v)≤a(e) and a(v)=a(e)⇒ℓ(v)=ℓ(e) for every (v,e)∈I. For T⊆ℛ, put b_T=|{C∈𝒞:C∩T=∅}|. Then F(d)=∑_{r=3}^{n+1}⌊1/(1+∑_{T⊆ℛ}(−1)^{|T|}b_T^r)⌋.
